score_metric: SI-SNRi (dB, higher is better)
human_reference_group: General adult listeners with normal hearing, the typical people who must follow one talker amid a competing talker at work. The comparison is to a median listener attending to one voice in a single-channel two-talker mixture at roughly equal level.

best_model_or_system: SAID (Semantic Acoustic Imaging Detector, PaSST variant) - top-ranked Track A team submission
score_metric: Macro-averaged Mask mAP (IoU 0.50:0.95), in percent, on the official DCASE2026 Task 3 Track A evaluation set
human_reference_group: General adult population with normal hearing, listening to the scenes (for example, binaurally rendered spatial audio). Sound localization is a basic perceptual ability, not a specialist skill.

best_model_or_system: ARK-ASR-3B (listed as Edge0/ARK-ASR-3B, a copy of AutoArk-AI/ARK-ASR-3B)
score_metric: mean word error rate, % (lower is better)
human_reference_group: General adult workforce: typical fluent English listeners who must identify spoken words in everyday work settings such as meetings, calls and speeches. Professional transcribers are used as an upper-end check.

score_metric: Word error rate (%) on the Seed-TTS-Eval test-en split; lower is better
human_reference_group: General adult speakers reading short English sentences aloud, as represented by the Common Voice speakers in the test-en references. This is a mixed population of native and non-native speakers with varied recording conditions, which is a reasonable stand-in for ordinary workplace speakers.
